title: Bounded Record Step and Seek Specification
statement: Let $N$ be a deterministic Turing machine with two Boolean work tapes, and let $s_0,s_f$ be states of $N$. For every Boolean input list $x$, natural number $p$, and Boolean list $w$ whose base-two digit value is $p$, assume $p\le |x|+1$. From every configuration $a$ on input $x$ that starts in state $s_0$, has the buffer encoding of $w$ on its first work tape at every offset $z$ with $-1\le z\le |w|$, and has a blank second work tape at every integer position, there is a time $t\le C(|w|+a.\mathrm{inputPos}+p+1)$ such that the machine is not in state $s_f$ at any earlier time, and through time $t$ each work-head displacement from its initial position has absolute value at most $C(|w|+1)$. At time $t$ the machine is in state $s_f$, its input-head position is $p$, and its work tapes, work-head positions, and output are unchanged from configuration $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a two-work-tape deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$x$ and $w$ are Boolean lists; $p$ is a natural number
The base-two digit value of $w$ equals $p$
The initial configuration is on input $x$ and in state $s_0$
The first work tape contains the buffer encoding of $w$ at every offset from $-1$ through $|w|$
The second work tape is blank at every integer position
